summary: Voyager Therapeutics filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026 carrying Item 2.02 (Results of Operations and Financial Condition) and Item 9.01 (Exhibits), furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release; the EDGAR header's Item 2.01 tag is not borne out by the body text, which contains no acquisition or disposition disclosure. Disclosed figures: cash of $132 million at Q3 2026, runway into Q2 2028, reduced year-over-year operating expenses, VY7523 PET imaging data expected Q4 2026, and first VY1706 dosing in the coming months. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or premium are stated. Routine quarterly reporting; no risk-arb angle.
